scope.checked_against: both policies evaluated independently on every same recorded snapshot and actor-only receipt history
scope.permitted_difference: only candidate actor 0 Market: current 16-entry price curve, curve note, execution_position, and the exact explanatory system clause

provider_variability.receipt_difference_basis: normalized receipt action, params, accepted and skipped; this count includes differences where neither action was accepted
provider_variability.matching_basis: round, phase, stage, actor; identical input means exact messages with an identical frozen model profile
provider_variability.temporal_order_basis: canonical phase order, then actor execution position within the phase; not inter-arm response arrival order

state_divergence.note: Snapshots are prephase observations; an earlier batch can contain differing actions whose consequences first appear at the next snapshot. Hash differences include canonical hidden state; public projection is not a full state reconstruction.

timing.basis: local started_at plus rounded elapsed_ms minus 1 ms; missing/zero-duration intervals excluded; not a gateway traffic audit

resource_delta.note: Total resource delta includes downstream world/response changes; the extra treatment input length is only one component. Peer-reported usage; USD price unknown.

outcome.primary: candidate minus baseline focal final cash
outcome.criterion: completed pair, focal cash higher, focal rank no worse, and at least one different focal Market action accepted in both games
outcome.label: invalid_pair_evidence
outcome.interpretation: One descriptive paired scenario. Even absent detected earlier drift, it cannot establish win probability, repeatability or a population causal effect.

limitations: Only one paired scenario, one fixed focal seat and one environment seed; no holdout, seat rotation, win-rate estimate or meaningful effect confidence interval.
All 100 players are fresh model-controlled identities in each arm. Distinct states do not imply independent models or independent statistical samples.
Alias, returned model names and token usage are peer-reported; matching names and temperature zero do not attest identical weights or deterministic inference.
The intervention is a whole information block including extra tokens, not a test that separately identifies price-curve versus queue-position value.
A higher simulated cash score is a diagnostic. Only rank one receives the fixed prize; increasing the prize relative to previous four-winner games is not evidence of intelligence.
This allowlisted report excludes local paths, endpoint URLs, peer identifiers, raw prompts, response IDs, content and error text. Private journals retain that metadata.
